}}'''Calwyn Sutoma''' is a [[bellfounder]] from [[Ebou Dar]] in [[Altara]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sutoma, Calwyn}}

==Appearance==
He is a cadaverous, impatient man with black hair.

==Activities==
His foundry is located outside the western walls of Ebou Dar. He does not know anything about [[Illuminator]]s and thinks fireworks are useless "fripperies", unlike bells. [[Suroth]] commissioned thirteen bells in a size that has never been cast before to be made by Sutoma for the celebration of the Seanchan victory over Altara. [[Matrim Cauthon]] tries to get information from Master Sutoma, but one the third visit Sutoma has the doors of his foundry barred against Mat coming back to bother him.{{Ref/book|9|18}}
